qualification: exact Tesla MAA 723 isolated DC comparison with an approximate catalog fixture; 150 mA resistor trial is an engineering probe, not a catalog regulation limit or thermal qualification

tesla_maa723_1986.use: Original MAA 723 (without H) 10-pin functional pinout; 7.15 V typical/6.95-7.35 V reference, 2.3 mA typical/<3.5 mA standby at 30 V/no load, <0.15% 1-50 mA load regulation at 12 V/5 V, and 150 mA maximum output current. Does not specify internal transistor parameters or guarantee 150 mA regulation in the model fixture.

robotron_pc1715_ic_crossref.use: A separate Robotron PC 1715 service-manual table maps T200/D2000 to SN74H00 and MAA723H to uA723. T200 has matching printed identity in K7222.11, while K7222.11 MAA723 lacks the H suffix; family comparison only.

ti_ua723.use: uA723C comparator: 6.8–7.5 V reference at 25 C, 2.3 mA typical/4 mA maximum standby at 30 V, 9.5–40 V input range, and 150 mA output capability. Behavioral error-amplifier parameters are fitted proxies, not internal specifications.

ti_lm723.use: 10-pin metal-can functional pin contract; 1.7 mA typical standby and 0.2% maximum 1–50 mA load regulation for LM723C at the stated 5 V test fixture. Comparable 723 family, not an MAA723 identification.

m723_ref_v.basis: Exact Tesla MAA 723 reference range at 12 V input/5 V output; does not specify temperature spread at other fixtures

m723_iq.basis: Exact Tesla MAA 723 2.3 mA typical/<3.5 mA standby at 30 V and no output/reference load; 1.7 mA lower engineering bound from LM723 family typical

m723_error_gm.basis: behavioral transconductance chosen to reproduce the Tesla MAA 723 1–50 mA load-regulation limit; internal gm not specified

m723_drive_limit.basis: behavioral base-drive bound with a provisional pass BJT; Tesla lists 150 mA as maximum output current, not a guaranteed load-regulation point or base-drive limit

reference_v.conditions: Tesla MAA 723, 12 V input, 5 V output; isolated reference fixture is an approximation

standby_current_a.conditions: Tesla MAA 723, 30 V input, no output/reference load

load_regulation_v.conditions: Tesla MAA 723 <0.15% of 5 V for 1 to 50 mA load, 12 V input; isolated fixture approximates catalog circuit

line_regulation_12_to_15_v.conditions: Tesla MAA 723 <0.1% of 5 V for 12-15 V input, 5 V/1 mA output; isolated fixture approximates catalog circuit

line_regulation_12_to_40_v.conditions: Tesla MAA 723 <0.2% of 5 V for 12-40 V input, 5 V/1 mA output; isolated fixture approximates catalog circuit

output_150ma_v.conditions: engineering proxy only; Tesla 150 mA value is a maximum output-current rating, not a guaranteed 4.9 V regulation limit

engineering_150ma_probe.interpretation: The 12 V/5 V/150 mA ideal pass loss alone exceeds the Tesla MAA 723 800 mW package maximum. This resistor probe cannot certify continuous 150 mA regulation.

lower_dissipation_150ma_probe.interpretation: Chosen at the Tesla MAA 723 minimum input voltage and input/output differential, with a 150 mA intended resistive load. The 0.8 W Tesla limit is a maximum package rating, not a guarantee of regulation at this load or a connected thermal qualification.
